guide_passage: Borrowed adulthood helps because the new voice does not have to win an internal election on the first day. It can arrive as an outside relationship, written plan, or concrete protective act and earn credibility through repetition.
next: The cynical voice, numbness, urge to scroll, anger, dissociation, or sudden need to do something else all belong inside the pl/ork.
